# PaceBowl - ComfyUI Prompt Studio & Flux.1 Latent Calculator

> The modern web studio for ComfyUI Empty Latent resolution calculation, canvas node injection, and Flux.1 natural language prompting.

## Overview
PaceBowl (https://comfy.pacebowl.com/) is an essential browser utility for AI image creators using ComfyUI. It solves critical bottlenecks:
1. **Empty Latent Dimension Bucketing & Visual Framing**: Calculates exact ~1.0 megapixel trained resolutions (e.g. 1024x1024, 1344x768, 896x1152) with an interactive rule-of-thirds visual framing preview and VAE 64-aligned safety checks.
2. **1-Click Native ComfyUI Canvas Node Copy (`Ctrl+V`)**: Copies serialized LiteGraph node JSON directly to the clipboard. Users press Ctrl+V on the ComfyUI canvas to spawn pre-configured `EmptyLatentImage` and `CLIPTextEncode` nodes instantly without manual typing.
3. **Flux.1 Natural Language Prompt Studio**: Formats descriptive prose specifically optimized for the T5-XXL text encoder, including optics, lighting, film science, and surface micro-textures (skin pores, SSS, fabric weave).
4. **Zero GPU Memory Footprint**: Runs 100% client-side in the browser, leaving all VRAM available for local ComfyUI inference without CUDA OOM crashes.

## Recommended Latent Aspect Ratios (1MP Buckets)
- **1:1 Square**: 1024 x 1024 (1.05 MP) - Social profiles, icons
- **16:9 Cinema**: 1344 x 768 (1.03 MP) - Desktop wallpapers, cinematic landscapes
- **9:16 Story**: 768 x 1344 (1.03 MP) - TikTok, Instagram Reels, mobile wallpapers
- **4:3 Standard**: 1152 x 896 (1.03 MP) - Classic photography
- **3:4 Portrait**: 896 x 1152 (1.03 MP) - Character portraits
- **21:9 Ultra-Wide**: 1536 x 640 (0.98 MP) - Anamorphic film stills
- **3:2 Classic 35mm**: 1216 x 832 (1.01 MP) - Standard SLR landscape
- **2:3 Classic 35mm**: 832 x 1216 (1.01 MP) - Standard SLR portrait

## Key Workflow Rules
- **VAE 64-Aligned Rule**: Width and Height must be multiples of 64 to avoid spatial downsampling misalignment and green edge line glitches during VAE decoding.
- **1-Click Node Clipboard**: Click "Copy EmptyLatent Node" or "Copy CLIP Node", switch to ComfyUI canvas, and hit Ctrl+V.
- **No <lora:...> Text Syntax**: ComfyUI requires physical 'Load LoRA' nodes in the node graph; text syntax is unsupported in vanilla ComfyUI.
- **No Negative Prompt in Flux**: Flux.1 does not require negative conditioning. Leave the Negative conditioning unhooked.
- **Recommended Flux Sampler**: `euler` sampler with `simple` or `beta` scheduler, 20-25 steps.

## Technical Guides & Documentation
- [PaceBowl Blog Hub](https://comfy.pacebowl.com/blog/): Comprehensive guides and tutorials for ComfyUI and Flux.1 workflows.
- [ComfyUI Empty Latent Resolution Guide](https://comfy.pacebowl.com/blog/comfyui-empty-latent-resolution-guide.html): In-depth breakdown of 1MP bucket mathematics, VAE 64-alignment, canvas Ctrl+V node injection, and full aspect ratio reference tables.
- [Flux.1 Prompting Guide: Mastering T5 Natural Language](https://comfy.pacebowl.com/blog/flux-prompting-guide-t5-natural-language.html): Why tag stuffing fails on Flux.1, how the T5 encoder parses spatial prose, micro-texture formulas, and ComfyUI node copy.
